properties.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with OLCI matchups
properties.description:
Per-profile CHLA metrics from global BGC-Argo floats (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), ascending profiles only, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < PRES <= B) from CHLA_ADJUSTED levels with CHLA_ADJUSTED_QC in {1, 2, 5, 8}. Source: Ifremer ERDDAP via argopy 1.5.0 (expert mode), pulled 2026-11-06. Matched to Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-3 4 km Daily Rrs (OLCIS3A_L3m_ERR_RRS, OLCIS3B_L3m_ERR_RRS; 11 bands 400–709 nm) for every profile on a day with an OLCI file (to 2026-10-01): the file of the profile's UTC day, nearest 4 km cell, S3A first then S3B. Columns pace_granule and pace_Rrs_valid flag whether the profile also has a PACE match, so OLCI can be compared with PACE on the same profiles or used on its own. OLCI Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked.

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
